svg.title: Groundskeeper — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as groundskeeper, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A long-handled four-tooth grounds rake sits beside a small distinct tuft of maintained grass. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
